docs.title: PyLine Core
docs.text: A lightweight Python framework for implementing the CQRS pattern with pipeline orchestration.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• Separation of Concerns: Decouple logic into Commands and Queries.
  • Mediator Pattern: Centralized dispatching for handlers.
  • Pipeline Orchestration: Seamlessly chain steps with shared context.
  • Type Safe: First-class support for Python type hints and overloads.

docs.title: API Reference
docs.text:
Mediator component that manages the registration and resolution of handlers.

Acts as a central registry where Commands and Queries are mapped to their respective Handlers.

Source code in src/pyline/handler_mediator.py 
class HandlerMediator:
    """
    Mediator component that manages the registration and resolution of handlers.

    Acts as a central registry where Commands and Queries are mapped to their
    respective Handlers.
    """
    def __init__(self):
        self.handlers = {}

    def register_handler(
        self, component: type[Command | Query], handler: CommandHandler | QueryHandler
    ):
        """
        Registers a handler for a specific command or query type.

        Args:
            component (type[Command | Query]): The class of the command or query.
            handler (CommandHandler | QueryHandler): The handler instance to register.
        """
        self.handlers[component] = handler

    @overload
    async def send(self, component: Command) -> None: ...

    @overload
    async def send(self, component: Query) -> Any: ...

    async def send(self, component: Command | Query) -> Any:
        """
        Sends a command or query to its registered handler.

        Args:
            component (Command | Query): The command or query to execute.

        Returns:
            The result of the handler execution.

        Raises:
            HandlerNotFoundError: If no handler is registered for the component type.
        """
        try:
            handler: CommandHandler | QueryHandler = self.handlers[component.__class__]
        except KeyError:
            raise HandlerNotFoundError(f"No handler registered for {component.__class__.__name__}")
        return await handler.handle(component)

Orchestrates a sequence of Commands and Queries.

Executes a list of steps sequentially, sharing a context dictionary between them. Output of one step (QueryResult) can be input to the next step.

Source code in src/pyline/pipe.py 
class Pipe(ABC):
    """
    Orchestrates a sequence of Commands and Queries.

    Executes a list of steps sequentially, sharing a context dictionary between them.
    Output of one step (QueryResult) can be input to the next step.
    """

    def __init__(
        self, name: str, context: dict[str, Any], steps: list[type[Command | Query]], mediator: HandlerMediator = None
    ):
        """
        Initializes a new Pipe.

        Args:
            name (str): The name of the pipeline (for logging).
            context (dict): Initial shared context data.
            steps (list[Command | Query]): List of Command/Query classes (not instances) to execute.
            mediator (HandlerMediator, optional): The mediator instance to use. 
                                                  Defaults to the global mediator.
        """
        self.context: dict[str, Any] = context
        self.name: str = name
        self.steps: list[type[Command | Query]] = steps
        self.mediator = mediator or default_mediator

    def context_to_params(self, step: type[Command | Query]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Maps context data to the parameters of a step (dataclass).

        Args:
            step (Command | Query): The step class to prepare parameters for.

        Returns:
            dict: A dictionary of parameters extracted from the context.

        Raises:
            PipelineError: If the step is not a dataclass.
        """
        if not is_dataclass(step):
            raise PipelineError(f"Step {step.__name__} must be a dataclass")

        step_keys = [f.name for f in fields(step)]
        params = {key: self.context[key] for key in step_keys if key in self.context}
        return params

    async def run(self):
        """
        Executes the pipeline steps sequentially.

        Logs progress and execution details. Updates context with results from steps.
        """
        logger.info(f"Running pipe: {self.name}")
        for idx, step in enumerate(self.steps):
            logger.info(f"Running step {idx + 1} of {len(self.steps)}")
            result = await self.mediator.send(step(**self.context_to_params(step)))
            if result is not None:
                self.context.update(result.__dict__)
            logger.info(f"Step {idx + 1} completed.")
        logger.info(f"Pipe {self.name} completed.")
